metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for the mdx-forge MDX runtime toolkit.

plugins.name: mdx-forge
plugins.description: Skill for the mdx-forge MDX runtime toolkit. Teaches Claude how to use compileSafe / compileTrusted, the browser module loader, and framework component shims correctly.

plugins.name: mdx-forge-render
plugins.description: MCP server that compiles MDX (Safe or Trusted Mode), publishes a live-reloading preview, and optionally captures Playwright screenshots. Ships two tools: render_mdx (compile + render + lint) and list_components (look up framework component contracts).
